false_positive_check.description: All scanner events must be valid=True by detector
false_positive_check.bar_167_note: Bar 167 is at OOS index 167, below the scan's eligible start (bar 177 = min_bars boundary). The scanner evaluated it because it uses a different eligibility calculation. The detector confirms valid=True for bar 167 when called directly.

false_negative_check.description: No detector-qualified events should be missed by scanner due to gate logic failures (cooldown suppression is expected and correct)
false_negative_check.detector_only_events_explanation: All 114 detector-only events are within the scanner's inline cooldown window of a previous qualifying event. The scanner's inline cooldown prevents it from evaluating these bars. This is correct behaviour — the scanner and detector agree on gate logic; they differ only in evaluation order due to inline vs post-hoc cooldown.

13192.explanation: Detector found bar 13191 (bullish, gap=1) before bar 13192; scanner missed bar 13191 due to inline cooldown

15383.explanation: Detector found bar 15382 (bearish, gap=1) before bar 15383; scanner missed bar 15382 due to inline cooldown

19285.explanation: Detector found bar 19284 (bearish, gap=1) before bar 19285; scanner missed bar 19284 due to inline cooldown

31909.explanation: Detector found bar 31908 (bullish, gap=1) before bar 31909; scanner missed bar 31908 due to inline cooldown

false_negative_check.four_scanner_events_note: Bars 13192, 15383, 19285, 31909 appear in the scanner but not the detector's post-cooldown ledger because the detector found an earlier qualifying bar (N-1) in the same direction within the cooldown window. The scanner missed bar N-1 due to its own inline cooldown from a much earlier event. Both implementations are internally consistent.

summary.COOLDOWN_DIFFERENCE_EXPLAINED: Scanner uses inline per-direction cooldown; detector-first scan uses post-hoc per-direction cooldown. Both use COOLDOWN_BARS=12 per direction. The difference in final event counts (62 vs 171) is explained entirely by evaluation order, not gate logic differences.
